faqs.q: Sec. 22-135. - Construction of lines, cables, etc.
faqs.a:
All construction of lines, cables, or other apparatus in the streets, alleys or public
               places of the city pursuant to the grant of a permit under this division shall be
               under the supervision of and in accordance with the specifications and regulations
               provided for such work by the city engineer.
(Code 1960, § 7A-4; Code 1981, § 9-6)
